ai_summary: AAVAS Financers Limited has promoted Mr. Manu Yeshpal Singh from CEO to Managing Director & CEO, effective September 19, 2026, signaling a consolidation of top executive leadership with an experienced industry veteran. Concurrently, the Board appointed Mr. Sanjeev Srinivasan as a Non-Executive Nominee Director, replacing a resigning director and maintaining key promoter representation. These changes, approved by the RBI, appear to be a planned strengthening of executive and board governance with no immediate red flags.
